What it means for fire-safety equipment

What the experiments teach the people designing detectors, extinguishers and habitats.

Smoke detectors

Smoke from Kapton and Teflon averages 105–205 nm, too fine for many light-scattering detectors.

SAME Final Science Report, Table 1

Extinguishers

In near-lunar air, droplet fires did not go out by themselves. Adding CO₂ or helium is what stopped them in other tests.

FLEX · PSI-69

Materials

Acrylic plastic keeps burning down to 13.5% O₂ in microgravity, versus 15.4% on Earth.

BASS-II Summary Report §6.1, p. 84

Ventilation

The weak airflow typical near spacecraft surfaces is exactly where materials burn at the lowest oxygen.

BASS-II Summary Report §6.1
Earth · 1 gSpace · microgravity

The same candle, two different fires

On Earth hot air rises and stretches a flame into a teardrop. In space nothing rises, so the flame becomes a dim blue sphere. In the Flame Lab, watch real NASA test videos next to reconstructions built from their measurements, including the near-invisible cool flame.

Photo: NASA Glenn (Lewis) Research Center, C-1998-485

All evidence was measured in microgravity. Moon and Mars gravity were never tested. Ghostflame is a NASA Space Apps 2026 project and is not affiliated with NASA.
